name: Physical Simulation Isomorphism
description: Replaced the explicit algebraic inequality (which models trivially simplified to a non-equality check) with a mechanical gear synchronization condition. The gear sizes (12, 15, 20) are mathematically chosen such that the stability condition (both gears complete >1 revolution before realigning) holds if and only if the gears have different sizes. This forces the model to either simulate the physical process or deduce the underlying LCM properties to realize it is a graph coloring problem.
